_info: Avis Google recopiés à la main (ex. avis qui parlent du karaoké, que l'API Google ne renvoie pas). Clé = restaurant. Un avis n'est affiché que si « note » (4 ou 5) et « texte » (texte français d'origine, copié depuis Google) sont remplis. « traduction » sert seulement de repère.

lagny-le-sec.traduction: It was a very pleasant surprise! Lovely atmosphere, beautiful decor, and the food was excellent. The savory buckwheat crepe of the day with Serrano ham, salad, Emmental cheese, melon, and port was delicious. Thursday nights are karaoke night! A great place with attentive staff. I highly recommend it.
If you want to eat really good crepes and be served by top-notch waiters, I recommend this place. Karaoke Thursdays are great! 👍
The crepes were delicious! The staff were friendly. Karaoke atmosphere! Very nice!
Super friendly staff and an amazing karaoke night!! I had a fantastic time!! Excellent food, a real treat!! Highly recommended!
Great atmosphere! Family-friendly karaoke, warm welcome, nice menu, never disappointed.
